methodologyNotes: Specs sourced primarily from StorageReview.com and Newegg retailer listings (with cross-reference from manufacturer pages and DigitalTrends reviews). Performance figures (read/write MB/s) are manufacturer-rated maximums; real-world throughput varies. priceUsd = US MSRP / starting price at time of research (June 2026) for the base/smallest reference config. Newegg current retail prices used as fallback where MSRP is unclear. Numbers stored unit-free; units implied by key name: capacity_gb (GB), read_mbps / write_mbps (MB/s), weight_g (grams). ip_rating is the full rating string (e.g. 'IP55'). release stored as 'YYYY-MM' where known, 'YYYY' otherwise. A null beats any guess. SK Hynix Beetle X31 specs are sourced from the official SK Hynix product page (ssd.skhynix.com/beetle_x31): 1,050/1,000 MB/s, 53g, no official IP rating; the drive IS sold in the US (Amazon US storefront, Newegg) in 512GB/1TB/2TB, so priceUsd reflects a representative 512GB US street price (~$60). SanDisk Extreme PRO USB4 (SDSSDE82) is the newest flagship: announced Dec 2024, shipped late Jan 2025, IP65, 256-bit AES hardware encryption. All sources accessed 2026-06-15.
